column6: Static test of the second SMART Demo solid rocket motor (BAMM!29 2.0) at Promontory, Utah on 2026-01-29; BOLE booster static fire also scheduled at the same test facility for June 2026.
Nusano hit its "Beam on Target" accelerator commissioning milestone at the West Valley City facility, first of three toward bringing the radioisotope production platform online by end of 2026.

Farnsworth died 1971-03-11 in Holladay, Utah; the page is scoped to his invention and development of electronic television, which ended with him — a legacy that is everywhere but a doing that is over (rubric ruling 1).

Feb 2025 NSA/USACE Environmental Assessment for a UDC Campus Expansion (two admin buildings, security forces facility, warehouse, solar and geothermal) to consolidate NSA-Utah staff on site; the PDF 403s to automated fetch but is indexed with content. No newer facility-specific artifact found: NSA publishes nothing dated about it, the $1.2B Balfour Beatty/DPR/Big-D award that surfaces in search is the 2010 original build, and 2026 Utah data-center coverage is about the commercial boom not this site.

Soundstream was acquired by Digital Recording Corporation in 1980 and the company folded in 1985 when its optical-card home format lost to the CD; the page is scoped to the 1975-1985 company and recording system, and Stockham died in 2004. No successor operating the Soundstream system exists.
Recursion filed its Form 10-Q for the quarter ended 2026-06-30 on 2026-08-05, with a Salt Lake City business address on file at EDGAR; continuous Section 16 and 8-K filings through August 2026.

The episode the page scopes ended institutionally when the University of Utah National Cold Fusion Institute closed on 1991-06-30 after its $4.5M state seed money ran out and no sustaining grants came; Fleischmann died in 2012 and the U runs no cold-fusion program. Fringe LENR work elsewhere continues but is not this page.

Institute-dated recap of the 2026 summer lab season (Native, Episodic, Directors, Ignite, Screenwriters, Doc Edit, Producers, Trans Possibilities) published 2026-07-31; the nonprofit is clearly operating, though the 2026 labs ran outside Utah with a stated plan to return to Sundance Mountain Resort in 2027 and the Festival moves to Boulder in 2027.

Telescope Array Collaboration status paper (Moriond 2026; arXiv 2605.19553, INSPIRE dated 2026-05-19) reports the Utah observatory still operating, TAx4 construction ongoing, and TALE infill recently deployed.

Page is scoped to the Promontory motor line, not the absorbed Thiokol corporation (rubric ruling 2); Northrop Grumman static-fired the BAMM!29 2.0 SMART Demo solid rocket motor at Promontory on 2026-01-29.

Frontiers in Neuroscience paper published 2026-03-30 reports chronic in-vivo electrochemical stability of implanted Utah electrode arrays using a Blackrock inserter, showing the platform is still being fabricated, implanted, and studied.

Utah Graphics Lab (Kahlert School of Computing) published Offset Geometric Contact in ACM TOG 44(4) SIGGRAPH 2025 (August 2025). RUBRIC-GAP: the page is mostly the 1968-1985 Evans/Sutherland peak (ruling 1 would read concluded) while the named program still publishes; rated the living program.

Stanford Geothermal Workshop paper (Feb 9-11 2026) reports a one-week circulation test at Utah FORGE with coiled-tubing fiber optics in well 16B, showing field operations continuing at the Milford EGS laboratory.

Direct Selling News 2026-03-16 year-end review reports 2025 results for Utah-headquartered public MLMs still operating (Nu Skin $1.49B, USANA $925M, Nature's Sunshine $480M, LifeVantage $229M); the cluster is contracting at some firms but not ended.

Peer-reviewed study published 2026-03-16 used the Utah Population Database (linked APCD, facility, EMR, voter, residential, and vital records) for a 475,582-person COVID-19 analysis, showing the linked registry is still being used for research (rubric ruling 6).
Standard-Examiner 2026-03-31: Hill AFB began its 2026 season of large open detonations at UTTR (one or two per week through September) to destroy obsolete DoD rocket motors; the range is operating.
Same subject as utah-test-and-training-range: Hill AFB 2026 detonation season at UTTR through September (Standard-Examiner 2026-03-31). Duplicate page pair, not a separate doing.

MIT Technology Review 2026-07-29 reports Zanskar's Lightning Dock well (online May 2025) still flowing >4,000 gpm after a full year and the 15 MW plant running at full capacity; the Salt Lake City explorer is operating, not just announcing.
